title: What a Resort Lodging Stay Owes on Departure for Servicing and Nightly Extras
content:
The departure services charge is what a Resort Lodging stay owes on departure for servicing the unit and for the nightly extras the party asked for: the unit type's housekeeping charge, its nightly charge for each dog the reservation records and its nightly parking charge for each parking space beyond those the unit type includes, the nightly charges worked out over every night the folio shows the party occupied. The elements of the charge are added together and the entry posted to the folio is rounded to the nearest cent once, at the end, after the elements have been carried at full precision. An amount that falls exactly halfway between two cents is rounded to the cent whose last digit is even, which is the convention the collective's finance office settles every folio on.

**The dog element.** The unit type's nightly charge for a dog is multiplied by the number of dogs the reservation records and by the nights the nightly elements are worked out over.

**The parking element.** The unit type's nightly parking charge is multiplied by the number of parking spaces beyond those the unit type includes and by the nights the nightly elements are worked out over.

| Element | How it is worked out |
| --- | --- |
| Servicing the unit | the unit type's housekeeping charge |
| Dogs | the nightly charge for a dog, for each dog the reservation records, over the nights |
| Parking | the nightly parking charge, for each space beyond those included, over the nights |

### A worked departure services charge (hypothetical figures throughout)

Take a stay whose nightly elements are worked out over 5 nights, on a unit type whose housekeeping charge is taken here as 200.00 USD, whose nightly charge for a dog is taken as 50.00 USD and whose nightly parking charge is taken as 30.00 USD, on a reservation recording 1 dog and 1 parking space beyond those the unit type includes.

The dog element is 50.00 USD multiplied by 1 dog and by 5 nights, which is 250.00 USD. The parking element is 30.00 USD multiplied by 1 space and by 5 nights, which is 150.00 USD. Added to the housekeeping charge of 200.00 USD, the elements come to 600.00 USD, carried at full precision and rounded to the nearest cent once, at the end.
